purpose: Generate a Reference-only numerical self-disagreement envelope before broad RossFast evaluation.
hard_validity_gates: hard mass requirement passes for coarse trajectory
hard mass requirement passes for refined trajectory
same physical parameters, grid, initial state, boundary type, forcing history and final time

calibration_construction.coarse: one Reference solver-seam trajectory over dt
calibration_construction.refined: two sequential Reference solver-seam trajectories over dt/2 + dt/2

pilot.role: prove uncertainty extraction is executable; does not numerically freeze final thresholds

broad_calibration_domain.initial_state_axis: predeclared effective saturation levels, exact values TO_BE_FROZEN before execution
broad_calibration_domain.forcing_axis: predeclared prescribed-flux levels/sequences within E0, exact values TO_BE_FROZEN before execution

threshold_candidate_family: max(independent application-resolution floor, preregistered factor * robust Reference self-disagreement scale), with any stratification fixed before RossFast evaluation
forbidden_actions: choose factor to make Stage0 RossFast B01 pass
copy GWSWEX 2 cm as a SWAP5 universal threshold
combine mass and state discrepancy into a compensating weighted score
slice material/state regimes after inspecting RossFast failures
next_gate: Implement and qualify the Reference-only B01 coarse-versus-two-half solver-seam pilot.
